verses.1: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.2: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.3: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. [ +w Selah +w*
verses.4: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.
verses.5: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.6: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. [ +w Selah +w*
verses.7: They that sing as well as they that dance shall say, All my fountains are in thee.
